entities.summary: Atvars Tribuncovs is a former professional ice hockey player. He competed for Latvia at the 2002 and 2006 Winter Olympics. Tribuncovs won gold in 2019/2020 season coaching Saryarka Karagandy in the Kazakhstan Hockey Championship league.
